title: Hilltop Sprint
description: Sprint from the lower fields up a zigzagging ridge, cross the summit and descend the far side.

signs.text:
The lower fields
Build a steady rhythm across the fields

The zigzag ascent
Reverse around the hillside’s shoulders

The rocky ridge
Brake on the broad rocks before the next cut

The exposed summit
Gain the top against the wind

The rapid descent
Follow the terraces down the far side
